author: Shyvalex
body:
Username: Amber26Theta (was theon502 when banned)
Reason for ban: Hacking.
Why I should be unbanned:
When I was hacking on Avicus, I was subject to peer pressure (as in, my friends pushed me to do this). Now, I have overcome those weaknesses and want to start again on the server I loved. Also, when I hacked, I was very young and didn't even think of the consequences that I could receive. I hope you understand that I have changed and this will never happen again. Also, I believe that I have waited long enough to be unbanned (3 years!). I understand that I will only get one more chance at this.

Thanks,
Amber

replies.body:
Hello,

Considering that you have been banned for this infraction for a while now, I have decided to accept your appeal. However, if you are caught hacking once again, it will be much more difficult to appeal your ban, welcome back.

Regards,

GalaxyBrit
